subQuests.subQuestName: Gather everybody and get the situation straight

130070101.text: Everyone gathers together. After hearing Nilou's thoughts...

130070102.text: Trying to best the Akademiya in a debate is attempting the impossible.

130070103.text: If you really want to try, I won't stop you. It's not like our situation can get any worse.

130070104.text: I don't think it's entirely hopeless. To Sharif, Nilou's approach will come off as naive, but that kind of frankness is exactly what they lack the most.

130070105.text: Things might turn out differently from what you expect.

130070106.text: I am in favor of such a romantic feat. No playwright will turn down a compelling underdog story.

130070107.text: Sure, in fiction, but I'm not sure how well that will translate to reality...

130070108.text: I—I'm not saying that I don't support you, Nilou. If you need my help, just say the word!

130070109.text: Anything is better than just standing aside and watching the theater get demolished.

130070110.text: I'm also pitching in. Let's show the Akademiya that we have some fight in us!

130070111.text: Thank you, everyone. I feel a lot less nervous with your support!

130070112.text: Not to rain on your parade, but my father is a real hard guy to deal with.

130070113.text: He is erudite, meticulous, demanding, and exceedingly familiar with rigorous logic. It'll be extremely difficult to beat him in a debate.

130070114.text: You all already knew that, but you just didn't want to hurt Nilou's feelings.

130070115.text: When all's said and done, aren't you hurting her just the same?

130070119.text: I just can't force myself to expect a positive outcome. Nilou shouldn't have to push herself for the sake of an impossible goal.

130070122.text: Yeah! It's way too early to give up.

130070124.text: We're up against the Akademiya. Everyone knows that they're very powerful. Being skeptical might actually be the more normal response.

130070125.text: But I still want to try. I'm reluctant to just let Zubayr Theater go.

130070126.text: And it's not just me — I think everyone else here feels the same way. If we're unhappy, we should speak up and let our voices be heard.

130070127.text: Say what's on your mind, and do what you think should be done. If we fail after that, then at least we won't have any regrets.

130070128.text: I mean... after all, the only thing we can control right now is our choice at this very moment.

130070129.text: ...I understand what you're trying to say. I also have my own intense feelings of anger and regret.

130070130.text: Then, could I trouble you to tell your father about our plan for a debate?

130070131.text: You can still get in touch with your family, right?

130070133.text: Then, please help us pass on my request. I've never participated in a debate, and truth be told, I'm still not really confident in myself.

130070134.text: But since we've decided on a debate, I'll do my best to prepare for it. I'll gather everyone's thoughts and let them be known to all during the debate.

130070135.text: I by myself definitely don't have enough wisdom to beat your father, but what about the entire theater combined? Then we should have a chance, right?

130070138.text: Beat the bad guy! Justice will prevail!

130070140.text: Hee-hee, you two, we aren't getting into a fight.

130070141.text: But thank you for your encouraging words. I'll do my best!

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the thoughts of theater members

130070501.text: I didn't expect you all to challenge the Akademiya.

130070502.text: That reminded me of my younger years... Back then, I feared nothing and no one, and I was always charging into the most dangerous of places.

130070503.text: I can't do things like that anymore, but those were some of the best times of my life.

130070504.text: Sorry... If the theater really ends up getting demolished, then you, Sohrin, and Abhi will all...

130070505.text: It's alright. There's no need to think such heavy thoughts. Even if the building gets demolished, its people will still all be here.

130070506.text: Have faith in the resilience of an adventurer. We can always figure something out.

130070507.text: But won't you have regrets if things just come to an abrupt end? It'd be like when you were forced to stop adventuring...

130070508.text: Ah, so that's what you were worrying about.

130070509.text: Relax, I've had a lot of experience with regret. Things are painful at first, but as they say, time heals all wounds.

130070510.text: Look at us now: Sohrin and Abhi are happy, and Sohrin has also just passed his theater exam. He can start acting soon.

130070511.text: He was thrilled because he can soon perform on the same stage as you.

130070512.text: We wouldn't be here if it weren't for our past struggles. And would Sohrin have become a happier person? That's hard to say.

130070513.text: Are you... trying to make us feel better?

130070514.text: Yes, but I truly do mean what I say. Being here at the theater has taught me an important lesson.

130070515.text: The most important thing about an experience is how you choose to interpret it.

130070516.text: I can choose to believe that my life ended with my husband's death, or I can choose to believe that it was a blessing in disguise for Sohrin and Abhi.

130070517.text: Similarly, even if this theater disappears, a new beginning might just be around the corner.

130070518.text: "Good" and "bad" are all human-made concepts. It all depends on how we choose to see things.

130070520.text: Nilou, I know how important Zubayr Theater is to you.

130070521.text: But you don't have to be so nervous — we're all here with you. The theater won't go down so easily.

130070523.text: No need to thank me. If anything, you inspired me with your bravery. You might have what it takes to become an excellent adventurer.

130070527.text: Alright, I gotta cheer up! I can't waste everyone's words of encouragement!

130070528.text: Haaah, I feel a lot better.

130070529.text: Good. My children and I will be cheering you on at the debate.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the thoughts of theater members

130070701.text: Paimon doesn't really wanna talk to him...

130070702.text: So you've already developed some prejudices against me. And to think, I was just about to put forward a suggestion...

130070703.text: Ooh, Paimon will listen to that!

130070704.text: Although, I know not if you have a new answer to my previous question. Now seems like an appropriate time to revisit it.

130070705.text: What do you think is the meaning of art?

130070707.text: We probably do need to tackle this question if we want to prove the value of the arts.

130070708.text: I don't know how to explain it, but all I know is that when my performance makes the audience happy, I also become very happy.

130070709.text: Does that count as a meaning?

130070710.text: You answered him so seriously! Careful, Nilou, this guy's ramblings never make any sense.

130070711.text: No, no, Nilou's answer far surpasses yours, and it is close to my own.

130070712.text: The meaning of art comes not from its creators, but from its audience.

130070713.text: In other words, only art that can be appreciated by others will impart its essence and value upon the minds of its audience.

130070714.text: This is something that the Akademiya can never understand.

130070715.text: You seem to have many stories of your own.

130070716.text: I once pursued the mastery of art, much like how a researcher would chase wisdom and knowledge.

130070717.text: However, the more of a connoisseur I became, the less I felt I understood. I began to question what it truly meant for art to be "understood" at all.

130070718.text: I knew that the most sophisticated works are often the least appreciated, and yet somehow, that provided me with little solace.

130070719.text: I remained ever perplexed about this conundrum until I visited this theater, and watched one of Nilou's performances.

130070721.text: Everyone here had a joyous part in the overall experience. The actors upon the stage basked in the love of their audience, while those in the house immersed themselves in the wondrous ambiance.

130070722.text: In all honesty, from a purely critical point of view, the performances here are exceedingly average.

130070723.text: Hey, don't say something like that...

130070724.text: But what bewildered me was how despite the performances' middling quality, they captivated their whole audience... they captivated even me.

130070725.text: I realized then that I had walked the wrong road. The mastery of art was never what I truly wanted.

130070726.text: I left the so-called frontiers of artistic research and came to this theater, for this is where I can finally find what I seek.

130070727.text: Art will no longer be a castle in the sky. Whether it be inspiring or entertaining, art must be appreciated by others to confer value.

130070728.text: If art cannot accomplish that, then it is meaningless.

130070729.text: When you put it that way...

130070730.text: Mr. Zubayr and I refused to follow the Akademiya's orders to change our shows for a similar reason.

130070731.text: To put it simply, we were afraid that our shows would lose their meaning if people couldn't understand them...

130070732.text: I once stood in the spotlight, but I relinquished fame and acclaim for the freedom I enjoy today.

130070733.text: I care not for where my feet may take me next, but Nilou, you need to remember one thing.

130070734.text: You already stand upon the finest stage there is, and that is a rare gift that should never be taken for granted.

130070735.text: You cannot give it up, not even to the Akademiya.

130070736.text: I understand. Thank you for your words of encouragement, Mr. Khasani.

130070737.text: Dust the cobwebs away from the eyes of those scholars.

subQuests.subQuestName: Collect the thoughts of theater members

130070901.text: Mr. Zubayr, we're trying to put together a list of arguments that might be useful. Any ideas?

130070902.text: It won't be difficult to explain our position. They're in the wrong, and they know it!

130070903.text: I have meticulously managed this theater's affairs for years, and I have abided by every procedure and obtained every permit.

130070904.text: I did all of that to protect ourselves if something like this were to occur. I didn't expect them to disregard the rules altogether...

130070905.text: This might have something to do with Inayah.

130070906.text: Yes, I know. But anyone who's staying at the theater is one of us.

130070907.text: If I can't even protect the members of the theater from outside pressure, then I have failed in my duty as a manager.

130070908.text: In summary, you need sufficient confidence and strict adherence to the rules. At least for now, they don't have the authority to demolish the theater.

130070909.text: As long as you double down on that point and force them to concede it, you'll gain an advantage.

130070911.text: *sigh* I've seen many situations like this before. The Akademiya sure likes to get its nose into everyone's business...

130070912.text: While you prepare for the debate, I will also prepare the theater for the potential aftermath. It's best to prepare for the worst outcome.

130070913.text: Once you're done chatting, do me a favor and tell our customers that we're canceling all of our shows.

130070915.text: Right now, no one's in the right frame of mind to perform. I have to consider both our staff and our customers. This is the only way.

130070917.text: With your talent and youth, you had the least to lose out of all of us. And yet, you were still the first to take a stand.

130070918.text: I've never thought about leaving your theater, Mr. Zubayr. I truly love this place, and I want to keep dancing here.

130070919.text: I also want to keep dancing with everyone else.

130070920.text: You're becoming more and more like her...

130070921.text: Do your best. We'll do all that we can, and leave the rest to fate.

130071101.text: You're here! Is the theater actually closing!?

130071102.text: He's been worried sick for a while now. He wouldn't stop talking the whole way back.

130071104.text: What exactly happened? Did someone come down from the Akademiya?

130071105.text: Yes. He told us that we have to shut down the theater within thirty days, and that it's going to be demolished...

130071106.text: What the heck!? That came with no warning!

130071108.text: Don't tell me you'll have to listen to him?

130071109.text: C'mon, you know the answer to that.

130071110.text: Yeah, it IS a direct order from the Akademiya...

130071111.text: There's no need to worry, though. I'm preparing for a public debate with the Akademiya.

130071112.text: If I win, we might be able to overturn things and change their minds.

130071113.text: Really? That's terrific. You have my full support, no doubt about that.

130071114.text: Mine too! So, what was their excuse, anyway? They still not a fan of the theater's programs?

130071116.text: Good thing they have the power to make rash decisions about things they don't even understand, huh?

130071117.text: Yeah, they need to touch more grass, not books.

130071118.text: Exactly. They want to look down on us? Haha, we'll look down on them first!

130071119.text: Don't worry, everyone here has your back. The Akademiya's recklessness won't get them any praise.

130071120.text: Right. They might think that some forms of knowledge are more valuable than others, but everyone can equally appreciate art.

130071121.text: If they don't believe that, send 'em my way. I got them beat on this subject.

130071122.text: Maybe you can prepare some questions on the details of dance performance to make things harder for them at the debate?

130071123.text: Hmm... Sounds like a good idea. Maybe that's something I should do.

130071124.text: Ignore him — he's joking. Just do things your way.

130071125.text: No matter what, we will always support you.

130071126.text: Thank you all so much! Your understanding and support make me feel a lot better.

130071127.text: There are always more solutions than problems. If you need help during the debate, just shout and the entire Grand Bazaar will be at your beck and call.

130071128.text: Heh, gotta show them who has the people's support!

130071401.text: There are signs that someone had stayed here very recently...

130071402.text: But we can't confirm if it was Inayah or not.

130071403.text: Let's take a look around first!

130071408.text: I heard it, too. Let's investigate.

subQuests.subQuestName: Inform customers of the shows being canceled

130071201.text: Abhi, have you seen Miss Inayah?

130071202.text: No, Miss Nilou! Miss Inayah isn't back yet.

130071203.text: Wasn't she just passing on a message? Does she really need this much time?

130071204.text: Could she have started arguing with her father again?

130071207.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! I think I've messed up big time...

130071208.text: What if Inayah never planned to come back?

130071212.text: It's just a gut feeling, but knowing her, she probably feels like she's completely responsible for what happened.

130071213.text: She probably thinks that all of this happened because she was staying here.

130071214.text: Oh right, as soon as her father showed up, she said that her father was targeting her. So she's felt like that this whole time...

130071215.text: She has a long-standing conflict with her father. That's why she ran away from home.

130071216.text: She doesn't think that we can win the debate, and she doesn't want to implicate us, so she thought leaving was the best thing to do...

subQuests.subQuestName: Get close to the direction where the sound is from

130071550.text: Ms. Rekhar has gone through a lot in her life, but she told us that she's very happy to live at the theater now.

130071551.text: Although she ran into misfortune, it led her down a new path in life. She sees that as a blessing.

130071552.text: She told me that the most important thing about an experience is how you choose to interpret it.

130071554.text: I can sympathize with your unhappiness at home, but after you ran away, you ended up at the theater and became one of us.

130071555.text: Those unhappy experiences allowed you to really cherish your bonds with everyone, and also gave you the opportunity to become friends with us.

130071556.text: Don't let your past suffering keep you from the new life that you've worked so hard to find.

130071558.text: Let the past stay in the past.

130071561.text: When I ran away from home, I swore that I would leave my family conflict behind...

130071562.text: But you're right, all I'm doing now is falling right back into it...

130071563.text: Maybe you'll disappoint him, but that doesn't matter. You have a new future waiting for you.

130071564.text: Don't let go of the answer you've worked so hard to find.

130071565.text: That's right! If we put our heads together, there's bound to be a way!

130071566.text: You're right, there's nothing to be afraid of.

130071567.text: I'm not trying to meet his expectations, so why should I give up because of him?

130071568.text: I can't afford to lose anything more... We have to win.

130071569.text: The debate will not only protect Zubayr Theater, but also allow me to settle things with Father.

130071572.text: Let's go. I'll tell my father about the debate.

130071573.text: I know him very well. Even if he looks down on us, I know how to make him accept.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go back to Sumeru City together

130071624.text: When we were trying to find a way to save the theater, we heard many stories not of the theater, but of the people whose lives have been touched by it.

130071625.text: Zubayr Theater is our reason for coming together. It connects us all in unique ways.

130071626.text: In other words, it's like a bond!

130071628.text: The theater provides money for Ms. Rekhar and her children, inspiration for Mr. Khasani, and enjoyment for the people of the Great Bazaar.

130071629.text: It also gives Inayah shelter from her family... It has brought us together after taking care of every single one of us.

130071630.text: And its story won't end here. In the future, many more people will come to the theater and receive its blessing.

130071631.text: And we'll all be there for them. Our warm, welcoming community will show them the same kindness we were shown in the past.

130071632.text: Aside from the delivery of performances, isn't this another reason for Zubayr Theater's continued existence?

130071633.text: Yeah, that makes sense! We definitely felt that warmth during the preparations for the event.

130071634.text: But, Paimon doesn't see how this will help in the debate.

130071637.text: Oh, gotcha. No matter how strong an opponent is, they'll have to go on the defensive if pressed on a weak point!

130071638.text: I feel like that's another prong in our attack. Thank you so much.

130071639.text: Paimon also feels a lot more relieved. Let's show him what we got!

130071640.text: Sorry for the wait. I'm back.

130071641.text: Things went a lot more smoothly than I expected. It didn't take long for him to accept the debate, and is set for two days from now.

130071642.text: ...Why are you all smiling so much? Did something good happen?

130071643.text: We realized that your dad might not be as scary as we had thought.

130071644.text: Hee-hee, we've just finished our prep. Rest easy, it will all turn out well!

130071645.text: We have to win... No, we WILL win, Inayah.

130070801.text: Although we can find a form of beauty in regret and disappointment, it makes no sense to just accept this world's tragedies.

130062801.text: This just came out of nowhere. What'll happen next?

130062802.text: Beats me. Everyone else must also be at a loss.

130062901.text: Due to special circumstances, all theatrical performances have been cancelled and the resumption time has yet to be determined. Sorry about the inconvenience.

130070201.text: I've gained a whole new level of respect for you.

130070202.text: Inayah was right. It's true that I couldn't bear to bring down Nilou.

130070203.text: It wasn't out of pity or anything, though. I just felt like I didn't have the right to say anything.

130070204.text: After all, Nilou was the one who bravely stepped up and proposed to fight back. I didn't have that kind of courage or initiative.

130070205.text: I'd be a terrible person if I spoke badly of Nilou without doing anything to help.

130070206.text: She knows better than any of us how difficult this path will be.

130070301.text: When the day comes, I'll get my friends and the theater's customers to come and support Nilou.

130070302.text: If anything goes wrong, I'll have them scream and shout and drown out whatever Sharif says.

130070303.text: ...Eh, I can't do that? *sigh* Fine, I'll think of something else...

130070401.text: No one is allowed to bully Miss Nilou!

130070402.text: Watch out, Mr. Bad Guy! Pow, bam!

130070601.text: Consider this as a trial by fire.

130070602.text: No matter the outcome, there will be treasure at its end.

130071001.text: Just notify the customers when you have time. There's no rush.

130071301.text: ...Looks like this situation is really affecting her.

130071502.text: There weren't so many big animals in this area before. They chased after me for a long time...

130071503.text: Sorry, I'm causing trouble for you again...

130071504.text: Why did you leave by yourself?

130071505.text: You really don't think we have a chance at winning the debate?

130071506.text: No, I just thought it would take too much effort.

130071507.text: Everything happened because of me. If I'm gone, then the situation will resolve itself.

130071508.text: But everyone else is trying so hard.

130071509.text: Yeah! Everyone's working together towards a happier ending. No one should be singled out for blame.

130071510.text: It's alright if it's me. As long as the theater won't get demolished...

130071511.text: You guys are the kindest people I've ever met. You shouldn't suffer so much because of me.

130071513.text: Even if you were the reason that all of this happened, no one would blame you.

130071514.text: Mr. Zubayr said that you're one of us, so that means we will protect you.

130071515.text: No matter what happens, we'll stand as one.

130071516.text: Nilou, there will always be a victim, whether it's me or the theater. You can't eat your cake and have it, too.

130071517.text: You can't win a debate against the Akademiya, especially since your opponent will be my father.

130071518.text: Why are you so sure of this?

130071519.text: My father is an extremely demanding man.

130071520.text: He's always wanted me to become an exceptional researcher and his academic successor.

130071521.text: I tried my best to meet his expectations, and did everything I could.

130071522.text: But he still wasn't satisfied... or rather, he had just never been satisfied with me.

130071523.text: I'm no genius, but whenever he berated me, it was always as if he was asking me, "Why aren't you a genius?"

130071525.text: So that's why you ran away from home?

130071526.text: At first, I thought that Father would slowly come to terms with reality, but he just wouldn't stop berating me.

130071527.text: For one exam, I earned the third-highest score.

130071528.text: I thought that all my hard work had finally paid off, that I could finally make Father feel some modicum of joy.

130071529.text: I even used the embroidery skills I learned at school to make a commemorative gift for him.

130071530.text: I thought... "Even this daughter can make her father happy sometimes, right?"

130071531.text: I see... When we were embroidering your gift before, I didn't feel like you were new at it.

130071532.text: Yeah, sorry for not bringing it up. These are not pleasant memories for me.

130071533.text: I was tired of him yelling at me every day. All I wanted was to see him smile at me.

130071534.text: But... He was more angry than ever before once I'd given him my embroidery and told him my score. He flung my present to the side.

130071535.text: "You think you should be proud of third place? Reflect on why you weren't first!"

130071536.text: I forgot how long I had cried for. I only remember my parents arguing. My mother also thought he went overboard.

130071537.text: They argued for such a long time. My father eventually stormed out and slammed the door behind him. I didn't get a single sentence of apology, or any words of comfort...

130071538.text: I've completely given up. We're destined to never understand each other.

130071540.text: I don't think you can beat him in a debate, because he doesn't even understand what kind of place a theater is.

130071541.text: He can never understand the relationship performers have with their audience. His life is devoid of camaraderie or friendship.

130071542.text: He just wants everything to happen according to his wishes, as if the world revolves around him.

130071543.text: What we cherish — our little place in this world — means nothing to him...

130071544.text: It sounds like your past has had a huge impact on you.

130071546.text: But, when we were preparing for the debate, I heard something quite wise. Maybe it'll help you.

130071601.text: Well, I'm off to meet with him. Please wait here for me.

130071602.text: Okay. Looking forward to your good news.

130071603.text: Phew, that should be everything. The only thing left to do now is to wait until the debate.

130071604.text: I'm not sure why, but I'm getting nervous again.

130071605.text: You were great, Nilou! Your words won over Inayah.

130071606.text: Talk like that during the debate, and you'll get an easy win!

130071608.text: But I still feel like it'll be an uphill battle. I need to be calmer, cooler, and more collected.

130071611.text: Yeah. I'm acting as everyone's representative, so I'll need to act brave, even if I won't feel like it.

130071612.text: There's still one problem left unsolved.

130071801.text: As things stand, there actually isn't much to worry about.

130079902.text: I felt that I might have said a bit too much...

130079903.text: Anyway, we better start preparing now. First, let's see what everyone thinks about the situation.

130079904.text: Alright, time to poll everyone's thoughts!

130079905.text: He really seemed to care a lot about the theater...

130079906.text: Once you get to know him, you'll realize that he's actually a big softie at heart. He'll even help out with furniture repair and painting the stage!

130079907.text: Wow, Paimon didn't think he had that in him at all!

130079909.text: My teacher. She was an excellent dancer, but she's retired now.

130079910.text: If we have time later, I'd be happy to tell you more about her.

130079911.text: I feel like the pieces are starting to fall into place...

130079912.text: Let's head back to the theater and organize our thoughts.

130079913.text: Sounds good! Inayah should also be back soon.

130079914.text: (No, there should be something else that's more relevant.)

130079915.text: (Not quite right, but it's close. I almost have it...)

130079916.text: (I can't seem to make a connection here.)

130079917.text: The most important thing about an experience is how you choose to interpret it.

130079918.text: Art must first be appreciated by others to confer value.

130079919.text: (Mr. Zubayr has been meticulously managing the theater. Everything checks out.)

130079920.text: (Everyone is free to appreciate art — no form of art is inherently superior.)

130079921.text: (Inayah really wants to win. She doesn't wanna lose anything else because of her painful past.)

130079922.text: (The theater carries everyone's feelings, and serves as the bond that connects us all.)

130079923.text: It sounds like we're getting closer. The voice is coming from over there!

130079926.text: It's Inayah! She's being attacked by wild animals!

130079927.text: Inayah, don't be scared! We're coming to help!
